inspiration: One sprite set, many looks: runtime colour-map swap per faction and per biome (art/VariantConfiguration.tsx:7; art/BiomeVariants.tsx:5).
The swap is gated to non-production or offline builds (art/Sprites.tsx:24): a dev-time check that keeps art changes fast to see.
Three attack stance tags (long, short, once) change how a strike plays (athena/info/Unit.tsx:70). Ranged and melee read apart.
Each attack kind has its own effect-sprite type (athena/info/AttackSprite.tsx:1): instant feedback per attack.
Typed registries for sound and song names (athena/info/Music.tsx:1, :88) catch cue-name typos at build time.
Unit names come from per-gender pools with a random helper (athena/info/UnitNames.tsx:8-9): cheap variety.
Fonts are picked per locale through a font stack (ui/CSS.tsx:9, :12): a per-language fallback idea.
